description: Convert a raster image element on the canvas into editable vector paths. The new vector elements are placed on the canvas; the original raster element is left untouched (delete it manually if no longer needed). Use for: importing PNG/JPEG content the user wants to edit as vectors, cleaning up screenshots into icons, or converting AI-generated raster images into editable shapes. Requires Quiver API key.

anyOf.description: Auto-crop the source image before vectorizing (default true).

autoCrop.description: Auto-crop the source image before vectorizing (default true).

sessionId.description: Session ID for per-session visual feedback. Optional.

sourceElementId.description: Element ID (or `#ref`) of the raster element to vectorize. Required.

name: vectorize_image
